## Summary

I implemented the disposable-domain email blocklist in `OwnerRestControllerV1.normalizeEmail`, the single place where owner emails are validated and normalized on both create and update.

Changes in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:
- Added a `DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS` set (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`).
- After the existing syntactic check, the email's domain (case-insensitive, taken from the lower-cased value) is compared against the blocklist; a match throws `ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ...)`, yielding a 400.
- Added the `java.util.Set` import.

The check runs after syntactic validation, so a valid-but-disposable address like `x@mailinator.com` is rejected with 400, matching the acceptance test. Non-disposable and null (optional) emails are unaffected.
